$comment: design §6.3 (design/session-distill/2026-10-20T1942--9684f05--mechanism-design.md) as data: the surfaces with their evidence levels in the design's words, the delivery states, and the one level this package adds. runlib/delivery_evidence.py reads it, and its fixture generator writes one frozen fixture per row (`delivery.py --generate-fixtures`). A surface whose evidence no producer reads yet says so here (`producer: absent`, with its reason), and every answer for a unit on it is `unknown` naming that reason - never silent.

surfaces.design: Executable invoked directly (hook script, skill script, tool, wrapper)
surfaces.reason_absent: no producer reads a transcript tool call, process record or receipt against an artifact hash in release 1

surfaces.design: Executable producing consumed artifacts (catalog compiler, installer)
surfaces.realization: golden until WP-15's installation receipt is installed and read live (lane L); the live case waits by name: receipt_live_waiting_wp15

surfaces.reason_absent: no producer reads a skill listing or invocation from a transcript in release 1
no producer reads hook execution evidence (Claude --include-hook-events, a Codex executor-side marker) in release 1
no producer reads a child's own record against an artifact id line in release 1

licensed_levels.$comment: not a level of §6.3: the baseline-selection history says what the owner's library had selected at the session's time, never what the session received (lead direction for WP-10, 2026-11-11). It ranks below every delivered level and above unknown, and its state is unknown, so the owner reads 'the library held this; delivery unknown' and never a delivered claim
